notes: The backup key is no longer baked into the APK at build time - it's entered once on-device and stored in this install's private storage. The APK is served publicly and unauthenticated so anyone can install it, which meant the old compiled-in key was extractable from the binary by anyone who downloaded it, defeating the server's auth check for every device. Existing installs will prompt for the key on this update; enter the same X-Backup-Key the server already expects.
